author: Tavmania
body:
Whenever I *actively* carry a kingdom friend into higher levels, I make sure that I'm in 1 party that only consists of the two of us. You may call me a control freak for that, I'm fine with it. But it's just the best way to make sure that whatever I farm at that moment, actually lands into his lap. It also helps to shorten up the time that we're wasting grinding XP mindlessly as T11's, even if the other T10's need it as well.     

As for your question, I don't know the exact answer. What I consider likely is that he started counting his XP way after you started farming, but that the XP did actually land correctly. I sometimes take screenshots of party members the moment they join my party, just to see if I've been lazy or if I've actually been putting in effort.  

My usual efforts consist of world boss farming + endless, it hasn't failed me. So far...

author: LazySoloDev
body:
If you get XP on your T10 char the XP is probably shared to the T11 as well as the T10 and T9. So imo you should expect 1/6th of the XP + 10%. Also the XP is often delayed. When I leveled alts I often needed to kill one mob to refresh the XP. 
I don't know about the T10 boss stuff but it's not impossible as 85m is not even close to 1/6+10%.

author: shuijikou
body: tldr. my understand：exp shared within 25levels，t11will not take anyexp from others，when a t10 go for dungeon run t11 will not gain anything/t9within 25levels will split the exp with t10 ，t11 go for dungeon run only t10 will split the exp/t9 will be too low for split

author: MudkipOnRattlegore
body: World bosses will not work as they need to contribute to the fight to earn rewards. Gauntlet and world is shared xp regardless of being in the same fight.

author: Babakanuch
body: How does range play into this? Because me and my buddy were partied and he would get 0 exp and I only got half of what was showed after a kill. Our level range was 1-3 levels from time to time but as far as how far apart we were was 124 miles apart. So how would he still be sucking up exp but getting 0%. Shouldn’t I be getting 100% at that point?

author: Other_Wrongdoer7173
body: I was also sharing a lot of exp to a friend of mine (we are both t10). While I only got half of my shown party xp, he didn't get anything when I checked. Is xp shared the moment i kill something or is there a delay?

author: Intrepid_Front2244
body: You will get exp from t10 bosses if you are within 25 levels of the person killing them. Even if you aren't t10. Anyone not within 25 levels of the person doing the work won't get the exp. There is also a 10% boost in exp you get when sharing ie 2 people within 25 levels of each other each get 60% of the exp instead of 50%

author: ShiShiRay
body:
Asking a similar question because I'm a bit confused by comments on this. 

Anyone not within 25 lvls of me killing, will not get any exp right? So if I kill monsters, the only ones to get exp are those who are within 25 lvls of me, but that is as far as it's shared. It will not trickle down to anyone within the other persons range right?

Lv 175 killing exp shares to only the Lv155 but wont share to those lower->150-140?

I know in other online games, exp trickles down even more, so long as the other party members were within range of the one receiving shared xp. This is what I was hoping to happen but it doesn't seem like it.
